div.div: 4 اتاحهُ , (S, A, Msb, K,) inf. n. إِتَاحَةٌ, (Msb,) He (God, S, A, Msb, K) made it (a thing) easy; facilitated it; (Msb;) or prepared it: (S, A;) whether good or evil; (TA;) لَهُ to him, or for him. (S, A.) One says, وَقَعَ فِى مَهْلَكَةٍ فَأَتَاحَ ٱللّٰهُ لَهُ مَنْ أَنْقَذَهُ [He fell into a place of destruction, and God appointed, or prepared, for him, him who saved him]. (Lth, TA.) And it is said in a trad., لأُتِيحَنَّهُمْ فِتْنَةً [I will assuredly appoint, or ordain, or prepare, for them trial, or punishment, or conflict and faction, or the like]. (TA.) See also 1, in two places.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
